about: photatl's total column against ftsspec_901218_5, and what photatl's zero level does to a fit. docs/solar_fit_plan.md section 4j.
relation: total = gain * ftsspec_5 + offset per page, least squares; offset/gain in continuum units; residual in units of file 5's robust noise

airmass_pilot.method: pilot pages fitted at zenith 0; X = photatl column / ftsspec column over the same wavenumbers (overlap >= 10 cm-1, neither at a bound)

zero_level_paired_test.method: 16 pages fitted twice at air mass 1.985 on identical windows: photatl as published, and with the offset undone (= ftsspec_5 to 0.023 sigma)
